notes.title: First Update After Demo Launch
notes.content:
Hey Food Fighters,

Today, we released a new demo version 0.0.5.

Since the first demo launch, we’ve received tons of feedback from various channels. Based on your feedback, we've made the following changes:

1. Faster default attack animation:
Players can now enjoy the gameplay more without waiting too long between actions.

2. Revamped unlock system:
Having too many new cards at once was overwhelming for new players, and farming unlocks became boring. We’ve completely removed the unlock system. All content in the demo is now available IMMEDIATELY. The format is now more like autochess, where all cards are in one pool, and RNG decides which cards you get in the shop.

3. One more free Archetype:
We added more food cards from India into the game to make the initial pool of cards to be even bigger.

4. Balancing update:
We’ve rebalanced several cards. For example, "Clown Fiesta" now gives +1 Strength instead of +2. Many other tweaks were made to ensure better balance for each reward.

5. UI changes:
The language placeholder has been moved to the main menu.

6. Backend compatibility update:
We've updated from Godot 4.2 to 4.3, which allows faster shader loading and a smaller script file size.

notes.title: Announced: Demo Release on 6th September 2024!
notes.content:
🎉🍔 Attention Food Fighters! 🍔🎉

Get your throwing arms ready because the Food Fight Fiesta free demo is coming in hot on September 6th on Steam! 🍕🥊

Our developers are hard at work, adding the final touches and squashing bugs like they’re overripe tomatoes. 🍅💥


Demo Content:
1/4 Main Characters
48/192 Food Cards
52/72 Upgrades
0/12 Downgrades
0/14 Twist
and more

Demo Playtime
it will provide at least 1 hour of gameplay to playthrough 1 run (13 fights). You can replay it as often as you want since each run is randomly generate!

Set Your Calendar!
So mark your calendars, sharpen your sporks, and get ready to join the food fight of the century! 🥄⚔️ See you in the demo on September 6th!
